messages:
Aisha (People Ops): Quick check - we're standardizing how managers handle mid-cycle hires, LOA, and conversions in review forms. Thoughts?
Diego (Manager - Infra): Agree we need clearer flags. I vote for a dropdown + auto-fill dates from HRIS if possible.
Nina (Manager - Security): Also add a simple "Insufficient data" option that still surfaces the person in calibration.
Raj (HRBP): We'll allow provisional ratings but require a "Flag for calibration" checkbox. HR will surface flagged items in the packet.
Aisha (People Ops): Ok plan: add dropdown options: Full cycle / Partial data (LOA) / New hire <90d / Contractor->FTE / Insufficient data. Require 1-line rationale. Pre-fill dates from HRIS when available.
Diego (Manager - Infra): Good. One more: how long can managers request an extension if forms can't be completed?
Raj (HRBP): Managers can request a 7-day extension via the Helpdesk link on the forms page; escalate to People Ops for exceptional cases.
PeopleOps Bot: Reminder: review forms due in 36 hours. Help: https://docs.internal/redwood/reviews/forms :bell:
